definitions.gloss: imagawayaki; round filled cake; stuffed pancake
definitions.explanation: A round, flat cake made of batter cooked in a circular mold and filled with sweet red bean paste (or other fillings like custard cream or chocolate). A popular Japanese street food and festival snack.

notes: Named after the {今川|いまがわ}{橋|ばし} (Imagawa Bridge) area in Edo, where it is said to have originated. This food has many regional names across Japan: ⟦{大判焼|おおばんや}き→大判焼き：27166_oobanyaki⟧ (Kansai and other regions), ⟦{回転焼|かいてんや}き→回転焼き：27238_kaitenyaki⟧ (Kansai), {太鼓焼|たいこや}き (some regions), {御座候|ござそうろう} (brand name popular in Kansai). The most common filling is ⟦{粒|つぶ}あん→粒あん：20790_tsubuan⟧ (chunky red bean paste) or ⟦こしあん→こしあん：20791_koshian⟧ (smooth red bean paste), but modern variations include ⟦カスタード→カスタード：25763_kasutaado⟧⟦クリーム→クリーム：00253_kuriimu⟧ (custard cream) and ⟦チョコレート→チョコレート：05183_chokoreeto⟧ (chocolate).
